title: Binance Wallet Launches Web3 API, Enabling Developers and Institutions to Build on Binance Web3 Infrastructure
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet is introducing the Web3 API, a comprehensive suite of API endpoints that enables developers, institutions, and advanced on-chain traders to programmatically access on-chain trading and market data through a single integration.  Whether you're building on-chain trading bots, portfolio management tools, or integrating Web3 functionality into your existing platform, the Web3 API provides secure and scalable access to Binance Wallet capabilities, including real-time market data, swap quotes, and on-chain transaction execution across multiple networks.  Discover Now About Web3 API: The Web3 API enables developers and institutions to integrate on-chain trading, market data, and wallet capabilities directly into their applications through a unified set of APIs.  Designed for flexibility, security, and scalability, Web3 API simplifies access to on-chain liquidity and execution across multiple networks. Developers can retrieve real-time market data, obtain competitive swap quotes, and facilitate on-chain transactions without managing multiple integrations. By leveraging Binance Wallet's infrastructure and liquidity aggregation capabilities, Web3 API helps teams build and scale Web3 products more efficiently.  Key Features: Market Data API:  Access real-time token prices, candlestick (K-line) data, and top gainers/losers across supported chains through a single API. Trading API:  Get aggregated swap quotes from multiple vendors, execute token swaps, and broadcast transactions on-chain — with built-in MEV protection. MEV protection mechanisms are incorporated; however, protection cannot be guaranteed in all market conditions. Multi-Chain Support:  Build once and access liquidity across multiple EVM chains (e.g. Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Plasma, Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Monad, Optimism, Linea) as well as Solana, with additional chains planned. Competitive Pricing:  Quotes are aggregated from leading vendors to find the optimal swap route.  Zero Service Fees and No Positive Slippage Charge (for a limited time).  All price improvement is returned to the user. Non-Custodial:  Binance Wallet never holds or accesses user private keys. The API returns unsigned transactions — users sign locally in their own wallets. Enterprise-Grade Reliability:  Backed by Binance Wallet infrastructure with 24/7 technical support. Who Is It For: Developers building DApps, bots, or tools that require on-chain operations Developers looking to extend into on-chain trading Developers looking to integrate Web3 wallet capabilities into existing trading or portfolio systems -  U sers are responsible for determining whether use of the Web3 API complies with applicable laws and regulations in their jurisdiction. Advanced on-chain traders seeking programmable access to stablecoin, native coin, and meme coin swaps AI Agent builders integrating on-chain wallet operations into autonomous workflows How to Get Started: Visit the  developer portal . Login with your Binance account (or connect with your wallet). Bind your phone or email and apply for a Web3 API Key. Follow the [Quickstart Guide] to make your first API call. Explore the full [API Documentation] for all available endpoints. Notes:  Web3 API is available in all regions where Binance Wallet is currently supported.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Binance Team 2026-06-17 Disclaimer : The Binance Wallet Web3 API is provided by Binance Barbados Limited as a technology service only and does not constitute the provision of investment, brokerage, order execution, custody, or any other regulated financial service. The Web3 API is not supervised by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of the Abu Dhabi Global Market or any other regulatory authority. All swap quotes are aggregated from independent third-party decentralised exchanges and providers; Binance Wallet does not execute trades, act as counterparty, or guarantee pricing, availability, or execution. Transactions are constructed but not signed by the Web3 API — users sign locally in their own wallets and Binance Wallet does not at any time hold or access private keys.
